pr_title: Bluetooth: Audio: Use MEDIA_PROXY defines instead of BT_MCS defines
pr_body:
This PR updates the use of defines in the media_proxy and the media_player.  The purpose is to decouple the media player (which is a generic dummy media player) from the media control service (which is a Bluetooth specific interface to media players).

To avoid dependencies, the media_proxy has a set of defines corresponding to the set in the media control service.
This PR adds two missing defines ("missing" in the sense that they existed in MCS, but not in the media_proxy.)

The media_proxy header file is updated to refer to it's own defines, rather than the MCS ones.
The media player is updated to use the media proxy defines, rather than the MCS ones.

There are no functional changes in this PR, it only switches some code from one set of defines to another (corresponding) set of defines.

Closes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41197
pr_comments: @fredrikdanebjer I can not add you as a reviewer, but feel free to have a look.

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Use BT_MEDIA_PROXY values instead of BT_MCS
issue_context.body:
Use MEDIA_PROXY defines instead of BT_MCS defines in implementation where suitable.
Note: Also involves evaluating CONFIG names

2021-11-16:
Addition: Use BT_MCC, not BT_MCS, for client functions
comments:
It has previously been agreed that the media_proxy.h should define separately the same values as defined by mcs.h (in analogy with HCI, I believe).  This has been done.

"where suitable":
- the media_proxy.h defines the MEDIA_PROXY_* values, and should of course use these (instead of BT_MCS).
- the mpl.c should use the MEDIA_PROXY_* values, not the BT_MCS ones.

mcs.c and mcc.c should use the BT_MCS ones.

review_comments: I think this is fine for now, but I guess at some point we want to abstract away from OTS for this (i.e. not use the term "Object").
Can't comment on unchange lines, but can `mpl.c` avoid including `mcs_internal.h` now?
No.  That requires https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/42965 to be fixed.
